en: The postcard consists of three black-and-white photographic views. The top image shows a riverbank promenade with people walking and a covered wooden pavilion by the water. The middle image depicts a grand historic building, labeled as 'Realka - Realschule,' likely an educational institution. The bottom image shows a street scene with old buildings and a prominent tower, labeled as 'Bezanijska ulica.' The captions are provided in multiple languages: Serbian (Latin script), German, and Hungarian.
